content.short: Wert is a checkout experience for NFT and Web3, enabling purchases with credit and debit cards.
content.description: Wert is a fintech company that has advanced payment technology in the NFT and Web3 space. It pioneered a seamless credit-card checkout for purchasing NFTs directly from smart contracts. By integrating Wert’s solutions, decentralized NFT projects, DAOs and other Web3 players can offer fiat payments to their communities while drawing on Wert’s compliance and regulatory assets. Wert operates as a regulated virtual asset service provider with licenses in Estonia and the United States, and maintains full compliance with the 6th AML Directive and the Bank Secrecy Act.
